geometry_note: IDs and names match the CSDI October 2023 Action Agenda polygons. These are historical planning extents, not verified current project boundaries or completed development footprints.
status_note: The binary status describes the proposed development programme, not every existing building or activity inside a polygon. Planned includes phased construction; none of these whole development areas should be presented as a completed operating technology campus.

areas.name: Ngau Tam Mei
areas.purpose: A planned academic and research district combining university facilities, medical teaching and research, and housing near San Tin’s technology industries.

areas.name: Sandy Ridge
areas.purpose: A data-centre development intended to expand Hong Kong’s computing infrastructure and support artificial intelligence, research and related digital industries.
areas.boundary_note: The historical polygon is not verified as the current tender-site boundary.

areas.name: Yuen Long South New Development Area
areas.purpose: An extension of Yuen Long New Town that redevelops brownfield land for housing, community facilities and improved transport connections.

areas.name: Lau Fau Shan
areas.purpose: A planned extension of Hung Shui Kiu combining a digital technology hub, tourism and supporting facilities linked to nearby Shenzhen districts.
areas.boundary_note: The digital hub is one component of the wider development area, not the entire polygon.

areas.name: Fanling North
areas.purpose: A riverside residential extension providing public and private housing, shops, community services and recreational spaces alongside the existing Fanling area.
areas.stage: Phased construction; existing communities remain within the wider area.

areas.name: San Tin Technopole (Outside the Loop)
areas.purpose: A mixed district pairing innovation and technology sites with a new town centre, housing, community facilities and logistics uses outside the Loop.
areas.boundary_note: Do not label the historical polygon as the current project boundary. The current 626-hectare project total includes the Loop; the older 609-hectare figure is not current.

areas.name: Hung Shui Kiu /Ha Tsuen
areas.purpose: A new district combining high-end professional services and modern logistics with housing and community facilities in the western Northern Metropolis.
areas.boundary_note: The industry park is a subset of the wider development area.

areas.name: Kwu Tung North
areas.purpose: A mixed new town district centred on rail access, with housing, shops, community facilities, recreation, agriculture and nature conservation.
areas.stage: Phased development; do not imply all existing housing or facilities are unoccupied.
areas.purpose_note: The official overview says the former Business and Technology Park land-use function shifted to San Tin; avoid presenting Kwu Tung as that technology park.

areas.name: Ma Tso Lung
areas.purpose: A planned residential extension of Kwu Tung North, providing homes and everyday services for people working at the Loop’s technology park.

areas.name: New Territories North New Town
areas.purpose: A planned border-linked district combining commerce, modern logistics and emerging industries with housing, university facilities, culture and sports.
areas.name_note: Historical polygon name retained. The current Northern Metropolis basic-information page identifies this programme as Ta Kwu Ling New Development Area, formerly New Territories North New Town.
